measuredFrom: tailwind.config.js:96-100 (easing curves); src/components/Hero.jsx, Sections.jsx, PageParts.jsx, Ticker.jsx, useParallax.js, RiveArt.jsx (real usage sites)
note: Exactly two easing curves exist site-wide per tailwind.config.js's own comment ('the only two easing curves on the page'). A third, ease-tab, is used only by the homepage hero tab rail and is documented separately below since it is not in tailwind.config.js's transitionTimingFunction block but is cited by Hero.jsx's own comment as a distinct curve.

tab.note: homepage hero tab-rail thumb only; settles at 421ms per Hero.jsx's own measured comment. Distinct from move - do not merge.

tilt.note: same curve family as move, used for grid-template-rows accordion-reveal transitions (FAQ rows, article-rail expand). Kept as its own token because the duration differs (360-375ms vs move's 500ms).

scroll-parallax.description: JS/rAF-driven scroll-linked vertical offset, never a CSS transition or scroll-timeline.
scroll-parallax.reducedMotionFallback: static; hook returns early and never attaches a scroll listener when prefers-reduced-motion: reduce matches

logo-marquee.description: CSS marquee (translateX loop) at a fixed real-world speed, not a fixed keyframe duration - track width is measured at runtime and duration derived from speed so px/s stays constant regardless of content length.
logo-marquee.reducedMotionFallback: REQUIRED but not yet wired in source (Ticker.jsx has no prefers-reduced-motion check) - flagged as a known gap, not invented as fixed. A generated PageSpec MUST declare a static (non-animating) fallback for this pattern regardless of source-code gap.
logo-marquee.reducedMotionCitation: src/components/Ticker.jsx (absence confirmed by full-file read; no matchMedia call present)

tab-rail-autoadvance.description: Homepage-only 7-tab product rail; white thumb slides under ease-tab, auto-advances on an interval.
tab-rail-autoadvance.reducedMotionFallback: static first tab, no auto-advance timer, thumb positioned without transition
tab-rail-autoadvance.reducedMotionCitation: inferred pattern consistent with useParallax.js's site-wide reduced-motion convention; not independently verified in Hero.jsx

rive-canvas.description: WebGL2 canvas animation (Rive), autoplay disabled until IntersectionObserver confirms the card is on screen - caps concurrent WebGL contexts.
rive-canvas.reducedMotionFallback: static poster frame (first frame of the .riv artboard, not painted) in place of the playing canvas
rive-canvas.reducedMotionCitation: inferred from IntersectionObserver-gated play convention; RiveArt.jsx does not itself check prefers-reduced-motion

timeline-slide.description: Homepage 30-day timeline: a dot and pill slide along a growth-curve panel on click.

accordion-reveal.description: grid-template-rows transition used for FAQ answer reveal and article-rail expand.
